title: Japan Is Building 30 Substations for AI — All at Once
description:
AI anchors Claire and Wenjia wrap the day in Asia-Pacific data centres: Mitsubishi Estate's nine-point-three-billion-dollar first move into the sector, Japan's utilities committing to thirty new substations for AI load, KKR's cleared buyout of STT GDC as a new AI hall opens in Jaipur, NTT building the power before the campus in Thailand, and CDC's spend-now-earn-later balance sheet in Australia — plus TSMC's $265 billion and the IBM profit-warning counterweight.

Watch the channel live: https://tv.leeheggan.tech

DC TV is an AI-produced news programme. Claire and Wenjia are AI presenters; all figures are sourced from published reporting.
